result.summary: The surface of zig_js is a standard Zig build script and manifest. build.zig declares the 'zig-js' module rooted at src/main.zig, a test step and an optional wasm example step. build.zig.zon declares no dependencies; I found no system commands, network access, code generation, embedded binaries or file writes outside zig-out, so nothing here offers a supply-chain attack vector.

findings.title: Test executable registered as an install artifact
findings.detail: build.zig calls b.installArtifact(test_exe), so the module's default install step would put a test binary in zig-out. When zig_js is used as a dependency, its install step does not run unless the parent build asks for it. This is a packaging quirk, not a security issue.

findings.title: Example step references a file not in the package
findings.detail: The optional 'example' step points at example/main.zig, which the paths list in build.zig.zon does not include. That step is lazy and only runs when invoked explicitly, so it has no effect when the package is consumed as a dependency.
